title: Addressing the Lean authoring agent
description: How to write for a reader acting as Lean authoring agent. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `lean-authoring-agent` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Mechanical and exact
rules.description: Mechanical and exact. Name the declaration, the error, and the tactic. A proof either elaborates or it does not.

source.quote: Reads mathematics and writes Lean. Knows the toolchain is slow and the cache is load-bearing; knows a `sorry` is a debt with a location, not a failure.
